description: This file is a shell script used for generating an appcast RSS XML feed for software updates, specifically for the OpenClaw project. It handles preparing release notes, managing files, and invoking external tools like generate_appcast to create the appcast file.

methods.name: find_generate_appcast
methods.description: Function to find the generate_appcast executable either in the system path or within the project artifacts.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Function to clean up temporary files and release notes HTML unless retention is specified.
